# Microsoft Graph answers

- `calendars.json`, `todo-lists.json`, `todo-tasks.json`, `throttled.json`: the examples of the Microsoft
  Graph v1.0 reference (`user-list-calendars`, `todo-list-lists`, `todotasklist-list-tasks`, `throttling`),
  [microsoftgraph/microsoft-graph-docs-contrib](https://github.com/microsoftgraph/microsoft-graph-docs-contrib),
  © Microsoft, CC BY 4.0. Contoso and its people are Microsoft's fictitious examples.
- `calendar-view.json`: written for these tests in the shape of the `event` resource of the same
  reference (Graph's own `calendarView` example is cut down to five properties), for Monday 12 October
  2026: a timed meeting, an all-day event of a Paris calendar as Graph returns it in UTC, a cancelled
  and a declined occurrence, an out-of-office day, a free event.
